sources.title: Stay on Track: Get Certified Before the CCNA Refresh
sources.notes: Official July 1, 2026 post confirms v1.1 through 2027-02-02; v2.0 from 2027-02-03.

sources.title: Release notes
sources.notes: Readable release notes: STP guards, cloud management, API authentication, AI/ML, Ansible and Terraform.

sources.title: VLAN Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE 17.18.x (Catalyst 9300 Switches) - Configuring VLANs [Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches] - Cisco
sources.notes: Catalyst 9300 IOS XE 17.18; platform-specific details are not universal.

sources.title: VLAN Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE 17.18.x (Catalyst 9300 Switches) - Configuring VLAN Trunks [Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches] - Cisco
sources.notes: Model VLAN reachability separately from routing.

sources.title: Catalyst 2960, 2960-S, 2960-C, and 2960-Plus Switches Software Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS Release 15.0(2)SE and Later - Administering the Switch [Cisco Catalyst 2960 Series Switches] - Cisco
sources.notes: Catalyst 2960 guide. Dynamic entries and unknown-unicast flooding within a VLAN.

sources.title: LAN and WAN Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE 17.x - Spanning Tree Protocol [Cisco IOS XE 17] - Cisco
sources.notes: Reason about one VLAN at a time; bridge priority and tie-breaking matter.

sources.title: Configuring Optional Spanning-Tree Features
sources.notes: Guard features have distinct failure assumptions; BPDU filtering can create loops.

sources.title: Understand STP Loop Guard and UDLD Features - Cisco
sources.notes: Loop guard is not identical to UDLD and does not cover every unidirectional failure.

sources.title: Layer 2 Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE Cupertino 17.9.x (Catalyst 9300 Switches) - Configuring EtherChannels [Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches] - Cisco
sources.notes: Passive/passive cannot initiate; bundle treated as one STP port; load sharing is not automatic per-flow multiplication.

sources.title: IPv6 Addressing and Basic Connectivity Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE Release 3S - IPv6 Neighbor Discovery [Support] - Cisco
sources.notes: Neighbor discovery and duplicate-address behavior; not ARP.

sources.title: Troubleshoot OSPF Neighbor Problems - Cisco
sources.notes: Timers, network type, MTU and interface participation are separate checks.

sources.title: Cisco IOS IP Routing: OSPF Command Reference - OSPF Commands: show ip ospf through T [Support] - Cisco
sources.notes: Read-only show command meanings; no local device output is claimed.

sources.title: Understand Administrative Distance - Cisco
sources.notes: AD compares route sources for same prefix; longest prefix match happens during forwarding.

sources.title: IP Routing: Protocol-Independent Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE Gibraltar 16.11.x - IPv6 Routing: Static Routing [Cisco 1000 Series Integrated Services Routers] - Cisco
sources.notes: Backup route must be eligible; a higher AD alone is not an end-to-end reachability monitor.

sources.title: Configure Route Selection for Routers - Cisco
sources.notes: Distinguish route installation from packet forwarding; historical classful material is not a recommended configuration.

sources.title: Configure IP Access Lists - Cisco
sources.notes: Wildcard match, direction, first matching rule and implicit deny; do not generalize platform reordering to invented ordered lists.

sources.title: Configure Network Address Translation - Cisco
sources.notes: Address translation is separate from routing and traffic authorization.

sources.title: IP Addressing: DHCP Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS Release 15S - Configuring the Cisco IOS DHCP Relay Agent [Support] - Cisco
sources.notes: Relay inserts giaddr so server can identify the client subnet.

sources.title: NTP Configuration Guide - Network Time Protocol [Cisco IOS XE 17] - Cisco
sources.notes: NTP supports consistent timestamps; a configured source is not proof of synchronization.

sources.title: Cisco Catalyst 9800 Series Wireless Controller Software Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE 17.14.x - Wi-Fi Protected Access 3 [Cisco Catalyst 9800 Series Wireless Controllers] - Cisco
sources.notes: WPA3 SAE and compatibility; configuration syntax depends on release and hardware.

sources.title: WLAN Radio Frequency Design Considerations  [Design Zone for Mobility] - Cisco Systems
sources.notes: Historical design guide: limit 1/6/11 example to 2.4 GHz regional/width assumptions; not a universal channel plan.

sources.title: Getting Started - Cisco Catalyst Center API 2.3.7.9 - Cisco DevNet
sources.notes: Concrete API uses HTTPS and JSON; no API requests are executed by the workshop.

sources.title: Cisco IOS XE REST API Management Reference Guide - Introducing the IOS XE REST API [Cisco Cloud Services Router 1000V Series] - Cisco
sources.scope: HTTP methods in Cisco REST API
sources.notes: Product-specific API semantics; REST does not globally require JSON.

sources.title: Cisco IOS XE REST API Management Reference Guide - Client Authentication [Cisco Cloud Services Router 1000V Series] - Cisco
sources.notes: HTTPS and short-lived tokens; workshop uses placeholders, never actual credentials.

sources.title: Coding Essentials III – NetDevOps Series, Part 5 - Cisco Blogs
sources.notes: Use only JSON/XML and request concepts; connection closure is not the definition of REST statelessness.

sources.title: www.rfc-editor.org
sources.notes: Primary ND standard, particularly sections 3 and 4; protocol details exceed workshop scope.

sources.title: www.rfc-editor.org
sources.notes: JSON syntax is not schema validity or device intent correctness.

sources.title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics
sources.notes: Section 9 methods and safety/idempotency; idempotent does not mean authorized or risk-free.

sources.title: www.rfc-editor.org
sources.notes: Single-area reasoning, neighbor states and broadcast DR/BDR; not a complete protocol implementation.

sources.title: 200-301 CCNA v1.1 exam topics
sources.notes: Full official v1.1 topic list readable via indexed search results, including weights and v1.1 additions. Direct page open returned CSS error; official v1.1 PDF URL redirected to v1.0. No claim of a fully retrieved current PDF. Mapping is partial and not a certification-readiness claim.
